page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor offering 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 6 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. It features 96 GB of system memory, providing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio with 8.0 GB of RAM per allocated vCPU thread. The CPU architecture supports x86_64 instruction sets alongside advanced extensions such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AES-NI, and BMI2, backed by 35 MB of shared L3 cache and 1 MB of L2 cache per core.

The instance does not bundle local storage, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for persistence. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps, while graphics hardware is absent with zero dedicated GPUs. In synthetic computing benchmarks, single-threaded processing presents a throughput constraint, with stress-ng single-core performance scoring in the lower quartile at 1310.88 and single-threaded gzip compression at 22.85 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core parallel workloads register in the mid-range tier, producing a stress-ng multi-core score of 10482.47 and a Geekbench multi-core rating of 5949.0.

Memory subsystem benchmarks show consistent mid-tier throughput, sustaining uncached read speeds of 71.39 GB/sec and write speeds of 43.14 GB/sec on large 256 MB blocks, with small-block cached reads reaching 584.87 GB/sec. In application-focused metrics, the instance achieves 10.13 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and steady throughput in database simulation tasks. Because instances lacking local storage require external storage attachments, overall system configuration costs correlate directly with provisioned volume capacity.

Given its high memory footprint relative to compute capacity, Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.3xlarge is suited for in-memory data processing, caching layers like Redis or Memcached, relational databases requiring generous buffer pools, and mid-sized analytics workloads where memory density takes priority over single-thread CPU performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.3xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 12 dedicated vCPUs and 96 GB of RAM, powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Configured with 6 physical cores and 2 threads per core, the system provides an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU allocation, 35 MB of L3 cache, and instruction set support including AVX-512. The instance bundles no local NVMe storage and includes no discrete GPUs, operating with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. Benchmark evaluations reflect average mid-tier multi-threaded compute and memory bandwidth, reaching 71.39 GB/sec uncached memory read throughput and 10.13 million Redis SET operations per second, contrasted with weaker single-core processing metrics. This hardware profile suits in-memory caching systems, distributed data processing, and memory-intensive database engines.
